entry: Bin branch: lower40.shift(1)>0 AND bbdelta>close*0.008 AND abs(close-close.shift(1))>close*0.0175 AND abs(close-low)<bbdelta*0.25 AND close<lower40.shift(1) AND close<=close.shift(1); OR Cluc branch: close<EMA50 AND close<0.985*BB20typical.lower AND volume<mean(volume,30).shift(1)*20
exit: close>BB20typical.mid; exit signal gated by profit>0; ROI and fixed stop remain ungated
catalog_difference_or_omission: BB40 is close rolling40 mean/std(ddof1), nan_to_num; BB20 typical uses qtpylib. Catalog omits profit-only exit gate and ROI5%.
runtime_boundary: Config and parameter sidecars can override class values; author runtime/config/universe unknown. Frozen research runtime is a hypothesis. Raw open nextbar kernel is execution proxy, not native limit-fill equivalence.
static_causality: Only current/past rolling/EMA and nonnegative shifts observed; no negative shift, external data, short methods or custom callbacks. Dynamic prefix/future tests NOT RUN.
execution_policy_to_freeze: Long only; simultaneous entry+exit suppress entry; exit signals suppressed while entry active under engine convention; fixed stop/ROI precedence delegated to frozen shared kernel. Profit gate only on signal exit, not fixed stop/ROI. ROI durations minutes; fee-aware returns. Cost/stake/warmup/window must be explicitly frozen by executor.
